account.participation_cap: 0.1% of causally observed follower quote notional in the prior completed three seconds
account.winner_removal: remove the largest positive 10% of routed event keys, release their slots and replay from initial NAV

chronology.conditional_development: every UTC Sunday from 2023-01-01 through 2023-08-27 inclusive (35 dates)
chronology.fit: every UTC Sunday from 2022-01-02 through 2022-06-26 inclusive (26 dates)
chronology.score_calibration_only: every UTC Sunday from 2022-07-03 through 2022-09-25 inclusive (13 dates)
chronology.untouched_fit_confirmation: every UTC Sunday from 2022-10-02 through 2022-12-25 inclusive (13 dates)

event.entry_state: first three consecutive completed 100ms states with residual in the 50-75% pullback zone and nonnegative original-direction one-second follower flow

execution.funding_boundary: full planned structural stop, matching the frozen parent executor
execution.source_boundary: accepted unresolved position pays full structural stop plus cost

label_and_route.label_available: both frozen 100ms and 300ms paths obtain an executable entry and structural exit without unvalued state
label_and_route.negative: any fixed structural invalidation first or a latency disagreement
label_and_route.positive: both latency paths reach 150% residual expansion before every fixed invalidation
label_and_route.route: trade only when calibrated full-model probability exceeds the calibrated structure baseline by at least 0.05 and structural expected value after 24bp is positive

model.baseline: one structure-only logistic using initial gap, pullback depth, leader persistence and target volatility
model.calibration: one isotonic map fitted only on the score-calibration period when both classes exist

promotion_boundary: Any survivor remains pre-2024 discovery; exact Bybit BBO/depth, actual funding, continuous full-calendar account NAV and causal sequential 2024-2026 replay are required before ranking.
scientific_question: After BTC displacement and SOL/XRP beta-residual overdelivery accept external liquidity, can one explainable ML meta-label identify which first 50-75% residual pullbacks reaccelerate to 150% expansion before reclaim/BTC-origin failure strongly enough to survive 24bp, 100/300ms latency and one-global-slot account replay?
smc_ict_translation: SOL or XRP extends beyond prior-only BTC beta fair value and accepts external liquidity, forming quantitative SMT overdelivery.
The first completed 50-75% residual pullback with nonnegative original-direction flow is the measurable FVG/OTE mitigation and the only admissible entry state.
One ML model accepts the trade only when pullback structure, flow, attention and leader persistence imply renewed distribution in the original direction.
Target is 150% residual expansion; invalidation is 25% residual reclaim, a 50%-gap adverse follower move, BTC-origin failure, a funding boundary or a conservative source-boundary full stop.
ML cannot choose direction, event, entry depth, target, stop, latency, risk or leverage.
